archive_scope: Two immutable findings files, provenance.json and payload-manifest.json. The package receipt is a separate file because it hashes the completed archive.
frozen_status_fields: Original findings are a snapshot of the review before preservation; their historical handoff fields are intentionally unchanged. Current packaging/commit/upload state belongs in separate receipts.
persistence_scope: Packaged and locally byte-verified only; coordinator must upload, freshly retrieve and verify before private-reference comparison.
prior_condition_exposure_as_recorded: The README identifies one base-model RAG diagnostic; this is not a condition-blind matched comparison.
public_payload_scope: Exact original findings (including generated answers, captured system instructions and paraphrased source rationales), plus hash-only preservation provenance and a payload manifest; no complete source transcripts, private references or condition keys.

source_review_packet_archive.hash_provenance: Coordinator-supplied identity of the actual freshly restored RAG review packet.
